title: Dashboard Demo: Billing & invoices
transcript_text: In this video, let's walk through the recent updates to the billing and invoices section of the Compass Mining Dashboard. These changes are all about making it easier to manage and understand your invoices, payments, and downtime credits. Starting on the main invoices page, you'll notice things look a bit different. We've simplified this view by aggregating all your hosting invoices under a single month. Previously invoices were split by facility, which meant, if you had minors at multiple locations, you had to pay each one separately. Now everything for that billing period is grouped together so you can easily pay in one go. You'll also see we've added a quick view option. By clicking here, a side drawer opens to show the invoice details at a glance. From here, you can quickly check the breakdown of your charges, due dates, and make a payment. From the main invoice page, you can pay for an individual invoice or select multiple invoices to pay. This takes us to the updated payment screen. Here you get a clearer overview of the invoices you've selected. If you prefer, you can unselect a facility within a month invoice to pay them separately. This makes it easier to split your payments across different methods or accounts. You can expand or collapse a facility to view its details. Now let's move over to the history tab. This is where you can view your past invoices. If we click on a paid invoice, I can see the details in the details side drawer view. Within billing history, there's also the payments tab. This page shows your full transaction history. We've added an option here to view which invoices are attached to each transaction. If you click view invoices, it opens the detailed drawer and lists all the invoices linked to that specific payment transaction. Next let's click the uptime summary button. This section gives you a visual breakdown of your fleet's uptime and your monthly downtime credit disbursement. It includes a graph in a table showing your monthly bills, uptime performance, and the corresponding downtime credit disbursements. This is designed to give you more transparency and help you self audit your credit history. That's a quick look at the new billing and invoices experience. We hope these updates make it easier to manage payments, understand your billing, and see exactly how your uptime credits are calculated. Thanks for watching and as always, we welcome your feedback.
